study.question: Can direct execution of the selected task adapter remove unnecessary residual computation while preserving this joint compression/task-conditioned model, its gradient ownership and its quality, and does that cost benefit hold under both folded Dice70 and unweighted Dice50? Observed limitation: candidate.py evaluates all four residual adapters for each of four tasks although only bank[:,index,:] is read. There are 16 adapter invocations per forward, 12 with zero output derivative. Folded support had click AUC 0.6668445431 at 367.840s wall/334.414s train versus full bridge 0.6667535438 at 364.136s/331.270s; fewer primary affine rows did not establish lower wall time. Unweighted support had AUC 0.6668114838 at 353.307s/319.377s. Thus removing useless residual work is a specific observed execution limitation, not a presumption that more compression helps.
study.hypothesis: Because residual_routing is fixed to task and each residual adapter consists only of Linear/ReLU/Linear, evaluating just residual_bank[index] on that task's existing features should preserve the selected correction, gradients and buffers in real arithmetic while reducing adapter calls from16 to4, without changing any learned capacity. End-to-end gains may be small because embeddings, coefficient construction, scorer Dice and loading remain. This is execution optimization of an inherited representation, not a new predictive mechanism or a novelty claim. Direct versus all must be compared within each normalization mode; folded versus unweighted is a separate non-equivalent normalization contrast.

nearest_work.difference: Archived arXiv1706.06978v4 primary text inspected at lines56-110 and285-389; target-local activation and Dice are inherited concepts. This four-task block-compressed model is not an exact DIN reproduction. The proposed difference is removal of stateless adapter outputs that cannot reach the loss, not a new local-activation rule or a replacement for Dice.

Pinned implementation90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d has Dice backed by BatchNorm1d(affine=False,eps=1e-9,momentum=0.01). No Dice invocation or buffer update is removed or changed within a direct/all pair. This is why pruning stateless residual adapters is materially different from pruning primary support before training normalization.

Pinned benchmark forward123-170 explicitly uses task-indexed sequence-hub projections and task-indexed towers. Direct task indexing is ordinary existing execution, not an original routing invention. We retain empirical block compression, moments and primary-owned item/scorer paths, with no hub aggregation or layer-wise broadcasts. Inspected benchmark source is not a reproduction of original INFNet or evidence of local efficacy.

Full supplied source inspected, SHA2568f9f4f1063997dfd5b98bae673db281c3cf429ab600a7b8c3dd53231a8e2aa71. All-bank task routing is inherited; change only execution of the selected adapter. Folding versus full already changed trained metrics slightly, so theoretical real-arithmetic folding equivalence must not be treated as measured numerical equivalence.

inherited_components: All registered embeddings, action-aware Linear/Dice scorer, four towers, four zero-output-initialized Linear/ReLU/Linear residual adapters, module names/order and RNG isolation are inherited byte-for-byte from g0-r0027-support_folded; no parameters are pruned.

Ten temporal blocks; uniform click readout and feedback-stratified auxiliary pooling; five target-match/ordinal/curvature summaries and match counts; rotated normalization support and attached support derivatives.

Only click trains scorer/item/action paths; auxiliary scorer parameters and item/action inputs remain detached, auxiliary context remains trainable; original four BCE default loss and host optimizer recipe.

Folded train compress50/affine50/Dice70, unweighted train compress50/score50/Dice50; both eval compress30/score30. Fixed population, historical masks, current unknown action and special-ID exclusions.
Frozen full-data one-epoch seed20262027,8192 batch,bf16,AdamW/Adagrad,100-event offline history and all host scoring/resource contracts.
study.proposed_difference: Add a non-learned residual_execution switch, with direct executing self.residual_bank[index](residual_features) and all retaining the inherited stack-of-four-then-select expression. Both execute every task's own adapter on that task's unchanged features. No mixed-task batching, affine fusion, detach, new state, cache, RNG operation, loss change or coefficient optimization. Cross this single execution change with the two already-tested training_support modes (folded and unweighted) in a2x2 suite. Within-mode models have identical state_dict schema and construction. General shared routing is intentionally outside this source's existing task-only constructor contract.
predictions: Within each normalization mode, fixed-state direct/all selected corrections and probabilities agree in train and eval; same-state running buffers and RNG state agree. FP32 probability/selected-correction max absolute difference <=1e-6; bf16 <=2e-3. Require both absolute and relative tensor-gradient comparisons (FP32 atol1e-6,rtol1e-4; bf16 atol2e-3,rtol2e-2), inspecting low-norm gradients separately rather than hiding them behind relative error. These are prospective engineering tolerances, not inferential performance margins.

Every residual adapter is still called once on its own task in direct, versus four times in all; no adapter parameter becomes grad=None solely because of this change. All learned parameter counts remain32129765 total,31793216 embeddings,336549 dense; persistent buffer names/shapes and initial values match.

Primary and auxiliary gradient ownership is unchanged. With a separate click-only versus auxiliary-only backward on the same synthetic authorized-input-shaped batch, auxiliary scorer/item/action gradients stay absent/zero, allowed context and selected auxiliary adapter/tower gradients remain available. Check at initialization AND after setting nonzero final adapter weights so zero initialization cannot make the test vacuous.

Within-mode host full validation click AUC/Logloss and four-task metrics should closely track the corresponding all-bank cell. A training-run AUC difference is a numerical/trajectory observation, not evidence that dead computation supplied predictive signal. Test stochasticity, nonfinite intermediates and optimizer gradients before interpreting any deviation.

Adapter affine MACs fall by75 percent (not total model MACs): removed12*B*(W*H+H*V), with W the residual input width,H=16,V=self.value_width; stack allocations disappear. Measure total wall/train time, allocated GPU seconds, peak memory, inference examples/s and batch p50/p95. A practical cost signal is >=3 percent lower train time or model p50 within BOTH pairs, with no consistent p95/quality regression; this threshold is predeclared for this exploratory execution screen, not a significance claim.

Folded versus unweighted can still differ in trained quality because they change Dice populations/gradients. The previous click gap is only3.31e-5 and cannot establish a ranking without authorized paired seed repetitions. Earlier deterministic bridges are reproducibility evidence, not independent seed evidence.
falsifiers: Fixed-state direct/all mismatches beyond the stated numerical gates, changed normalization buffers/RNG, mask dependence, parameter schema/count change or altered source-gradient ownership falsify correctness for the proposed implementation; retain failure costs and do not call it an equivalent execution.

Any nonfinite unselected intermediate in all-bank mode can contaminate zero-gradient branches; this violates the finite-computation assumption. Diagnose and retain the finding rather than asserting algebraic zero automatically implies finite-gradient parity.
Passing correctness but no consistent measured end-to-end time/memory improvement falsifies practical cost usefulness here; fewer adapter operations alone are not success.

If any apparent AUC improvement comes with parity failure or cannot be distinguished from training arithmetic and selection over many validation trials, do not claim a predictive mechanism. A lower auxiliary AUC remains a reported cost of the inherited click-optimized model.

Historical results are insufficient for repeated support: no confidence or superiority claim over the two frozen source bests solely from one selected seed, and no generalization beyond official_offline inputs.
alternative_explanations: GPU load, allocator/kernel cache, launch scheduling, data loading and run order can explain timing differences; same-round all-bank controls and model-only batch latency distinguish them partially.

Removing graph branches changes floating-point gradient accumulation order; bf16 training can amplify tiny differences. Source equality and real-arithmetic reasoning do not substitute for host gradient, buffer and trained-metric checks.
Primary normalization remains the dominant compute or memory term; branch dispatch may not improve total wall time even with fewer adapter calls.

Apparent folded quality advantage can reflect selected-seed noise/arithmetic rather than useful duplicate normalization mass. Factorial execution controls cannot by themselves resolve seed uncertainty.

The broader history/task mechanism is inherited and jointly tuned through many rounds. Earlier compressed_task0.659194 < events_task0.660163 and frozen compression source0.660647 shows simple combination failed; match detail/task routes0.663019 and later ordinal/normalization trajectories improved, while removing moment families or support gradients degraded. These controlled implementation observations do not establish novelty or universal complementarity.

The click-selected incumbent auxiliary AUCs (cart0.779317,fav0.787474,buy0.758254) are materially below initial DIN (0.849070,0.864897,0.870182). Do not present click improvement as uniform four-task improvement.

Round27 folding did not establish wall-time benefit, and its quality gaps are single-seed/arithmetic observations. knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: No external architecture adopted. Directly execute the existing selected task adapter; preserve the inherited compressed-history, moment and source-gradient mechanisms.

knowledge_assessments.falsifier: This suite cannot refute or establish effectiveness of the external architecture. Test its own primary-source-derived implementation at matched information/capacity/cost to answer that. For current direct execution, failed numerical/gradient/mask parity or absent measured cost benefit rejects the claimed implementation utility.
